page.layout: One page of text, one column, centred; a dedication with date and signature lines. Left edge shows the neighbouring page (not transcribed). Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: DEDICATORIA.
main_text.p: fime, cui multis ille nominibus debetur, volens & lubens inscribo: Atque Libellum ipsum toto suo succo & sanguine, meae erga te perennis observantiae monimentum esse jubeo. Vale.
Dabam Lugduni Batavor. 1 v. Januarii MDCLXV.

page.notes: The left strip shows text from the adjacent page and is not transcribed. "fime," is a fragment at the page start (end of "Serenissime"). The date numeral "1 v." is copied as printed; the reversed-C glyph in "MDCLXV" is read as C. No page number or running head is printed.
